text: こどもの　くせに　おまえの　ポケモン　ずいぶん　なついているな

structure.en: even though you're just a kid

structure.jp: おまえの　ポケモン
ずいぶん　なついているな

patterns.name: 〜くせに
patterns.explanation: くせに means 'even though', with a tone of looking down or grudging surprise. こどもの くせに = 'even though you're only a kid'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here shows a state that holds now. なついている = 'are attached to you'.

patterns.name: 〜な (exclamation)
patterns.explanation: な at the end shows the speaker is impressed or thinking aloud. なついているな = 'they sure are attached to you'.
